examples.title: Example 1: Implementing a Chip Group Without a Builder-defined Suffix
examples.description: This example shows how to implement a chip group without a builder-defined suffix.

examples.title: Example 2: Implementing a Chip Group with a Builder-defined Suffix
examples.description: This example shows how to implement a chip group with a builder-defined suffix.

examples.title: Example 3: Setting the Symbol Icon
examples.description: This example implements IconGroupSuffix and ChipGroup with SymbolGlyph resources.

examples.title: Example 4: Implementing the Screen Reader Feature for the Single-Selection Scenario
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to implement the screen reader feature for a chip group with and without a suffix area in single-selection mode. The content to be read is the value of the accessibilityText attribute.

examples.title: Example 5: Implementing the Screen Reader Feature for the Multi-selection Scenario
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to implement the screen reader feature for a chip group with and without a suffix area in multi-selection mode. The content to be read is the value of the accessibilityText attribute.
